name: Anthropic
description: Read-only Anthropic access: the account's catalogue of available Claude models. Sending a message is a billable POST against the account's usage, so it is modelled as write:true and HITL-gated rather than fired here. Auth is TWO parts: the x-api-key header (the secret) plus a constant anthropic-version header Anthropic requires on every request, which this spec sets as a static_headers entry since it is a public API version string, not a credential.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List the Claude models available to this API key, with their display name and creation date

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a message to a Claude model via the Messages API. This spends the account's token usage, so it is HITL-gated and never fired by the shape-proof harness (write:true means blind proof always SKIPs it; a real credential would also need --include-writes)

model.description: Anthropic model id to route to (e.g. claude-3-5-haiku-20241022), from list_models

max_tokens.description: Maximum tokens to generate (required by the Messages API)

_scaffold.source: hand-authored 2026-09-16, frontier-LLM gap fill batch B (project_ai_tools_coverage_gaps_2026_09_16)
needs_review: NO LIVE CREDENTIAL AT AUTHORING TIME: this spec is shape-proved blind only. LIVE_PROVEN needs one real sk-ant- key against /v1/models, a zero-spend authed read per the coverage-gap plan.

The anthropic-version header (2023-06-01) is a documented public API version constant, not a secret; it is committed as a static_headers literal and applies to every request the runtime and the shape-proof harness fire, including /v1/models.

send_message is the only write:true tool: it is modelled for completeness but deliberately carries no _probe and is skipped by the shape-proof harness by default (writes_not_included), and even with --include-writes it only fires if the test call already proved an auth gate.
credentialType 'anthropic' reuses the PRE-EXISTING vault type in integrationTypeRegistry.js (api_key field, sk-ant- prefix); no vault change needed for this connector.
